title: Grounded consciousness is not crowded out as a cause

statements.text: If the micro-level is causally closed, dualist consciousness seems to have nothing left to do. Constitutive panpsychism avoids this: a grounded fact is not crowded out by its grounds, as a party keeping a neighbor awake is not crowded out by the dancing it consists in, so human consciousness inherits the causal role of the micro-level consciousness it consists in.

sources.quote: The constitutive panpsychist avoids this worry, as the causally efficacy of grounded facts are not 'crowded out' by the causal efficacy of their grounds.
constitutive Russellian panpsychism is compatible with a robust causal role for both microexperience and macroexperience
